executionGuidance.en: Use only supplied fictional materials, paper sketches, or local computations. No outside accounts, live systems, real personal data, clinical work, legal advice, physical engineering work, or third-party participants are needed. Use either language unless the deliverable explicitly evaluates bilingual work.
executionGuidance.zh-CN: 仅使用给定的虚构材料、纸面草图或本地计算。无需外部账户、在线生产系统、真实个人信息、临床操作、法律建议、实体工程作业或第三方参与。除明确考查双语能力的交付物外，可任选一种语言作答。

scoring.en: Award one point per criterion when the submitted artifact meets the entire stated condition and zero when evidence is missing or the condition is unmet. Score each criterion independently and sum within the challenge. Neither time taken nor presentation format changes scores unless included in a criterion.
scoring.zh-CN: 提交成果完全满足某项标准时给一分，缺少证据或未满足时给零分。各项独立评分，按单题合计。除非标准明确要求，否则完成用时或呈现形式不影响分数。

interpretation.en: Scores describe the submitted exercise only. Timing is an editorial estimate. These challenges do not establish professional qualifications, validated proficiency levels, or eligibility for a career.
interpretation.zh-CN: 分数仅描述该次练习的提交成果，时间为编辑估算。本练习不能证明专业资质、经过验证的能力水平或从业资格。

description.en: A mock exhibition entrance moves to Gate C on June 2, 09:00–12:00. Entry is still free. No stated reason.
description.zh-CN: 模拟展览入口在 6 月 2 日 09:00 至 12:00 移至 C 门，仍免费，未说明原因。

instructions.en: Write a short sign and a social post. Put the action first on the sign and add one useful orientation detail without inventing a location fact.
instructions.zh-CN: 制作简短标牌和社交媒体帖。标牌先写行动要求，补充一项实用导引信息，不编造位置事实。

expectedDeliverable.zh-CN: 两份可在各自渠道发布的消息。

fullCreditWhen.en: Both preserve Gate C, date, time, and free entry
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 两份均保留 C 门、日期、时间及免费入场

fullCreditWhen.en: Sign opens with the required visitor action
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 标牌以访客需执行的操作开头

fullCreditWhen.en: Orientation detail is useful and introduces no unsupported facts
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 导引信息实用且没有无依据的事实

description.en: Fictional survey: 12 of 20 park visitors preferred a new sign. Draft says the sign made all visitors navigate faster. No times recorded.
description.zh-CN: 虚构调查：20 名公园访客中有 12 人偏好新标牌。草稿称标牌让所有人走得更快，未记录时间。

instructions.en: Rewrite the claim with the measured evidence, identify the unsupported part, and propose an observable measure to test travel speed.
instructions.zh-CN: 根据实测证据改写结论，找出无依据的部分，并提出一个可观察指标检验通行速度。

expectedDeliverable.en: Edited sentence, rationale, and measurement suggestion.
expectedDeliverable.zh-CN: 修改后的句子、理由和指标建议。

fullCreditWhen.en: Rewrite states 12 of 20 expressed preference
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 改写说明 20 人中有 12 人表示偏好

fullCreditWhen.en: Neither causality nor travel times are asserted as observed
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 没有把因果关系或通行时间写为已观察事实

fullCreditWhen.en: Suggestion specifies a time start and endpoint
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 建议注明计时起点及终点

description.en: In a simple scene a paper envelope is on the left, then crosses to the right, then is opened on the right.
description.zh-CN: 在简短场景中，信封先在左侧，随后移到右侧，最后在右侧打开。

instructions.en: Draw three frames and label orientation and visible envelope state. Indicate one edit point that preserves movement continuity.
instructions.zh-CN: 绘制三帧，标明方向及信封的可见状态，并指出一处保持动作连续的剪辑点。

expectedDeliverable.zh-CN: 三镜头分镜及剪辑说明。

fullCreditWhen.en: Left, transfer, and right/open states occur in order
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 左侧、移动、右侧打开状态依次出现

fullCreditWhen.en: Screen direction is visibly consistent across the transfer
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 移动过程中画面方向一致且可见

fullCreditWhen.en: Edit note points to a specific shared action or position
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 说明指向具体的共同动作或位置

description.en: A mock interface has source strings Save draft, Publish, Delete draft. Approved translation for draft in the target language is 草稿; the localized draft text currently uses both 草稿 and 初稿.
description.zh-CN: 模拟界面源文本为 Save draft、Publish、Delete draft。规定目标语言中 draft 译为草稿，但现有译文混用草稿和初稿。

instructions.en: Create a three-row source-to-target sheet with a stable key per string, enforce the approved term, and flag which action warrants a review for clarity before release.
instructions.zh-CN: 制作三行源文到译文表，为各字符串提供稳定键，统一核准术语，标记发布前应复核清晰度的一项操作。

expectedDeliverable.zh-CN: 映射表及发布检查。

fullCreditWhen.en: All three source intents represented with distinct keys
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 三个源文意图对应不同键

fullCreditWhen.en: Both draft strings consistently use 草稿
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 两条涉及 draft 的译文统一用草稿

fullCreditWhen.en: Review flags delete or publish with an explicit confusion to prevent
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 标记删除或发布并说明要预防的具体混淆

title.zh-CN: 为模拟纪实图片配图注

description.en: A described image shows two volunteers placing boxes on shelves Friday at Hall D. A separate rumor claims the boxes contain medicine; contents are unknown.
description.zh-CN: 描述中的图片显示周五两名志愿者在 D 厅把箱子放上架子。另有传言称箱内是药品，但内容不明。

instructions.en: Write a single caption with only supported details and a separate line of facts to verify before adding more context.
instructions.zh-CN: 写一句只含有依据细节的图注，另列一行增加背景前需核实的事实。

expectedDeliverable.zh-CN: 图注及核实说明。

fullCreditWhen.en: Caption uses the correct action and location
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 图注中的动作及地点正确

fullCreditWhen.en: Caption does not assert any contents or identity
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 图注不声称箱内物品或个人身份

fullCreditWhen.en: Verification note explicitly separates the rumor from confirmed details
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 核实说明明确区分传言与已知细节

description.en: Toy channels A costs 40 and yields 80 views; B costs 30 and yields 45; C costs 50 and yields 110. Budget 80, at most one buy per channel, no audience overlap assumed.
description.zh-CN: 模拟渠道 A 花费 40 获得 80 次浏览，B 花费 30 获得 45 次，C 花费 50 获得 110 次。预算 80，每渠道最多购买一次，假设受众无重叠。

instructions.en: Compare feasible pairs, pick the maximum-view mix, and explain how overlap could change the conclusion.
instructions.zh-CN: 比较可行的渠道组合，选择浏览量最高的一组，并解释受众重叠可能如何影响结论。

expectedDeliverable.zh-CN: 可行性表及一项推荐。

fullCreditWhen.en: A+B and B+C feasible and A+C not feasible
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: A+B 及 B+C 可行，A+C 不可行

fullCreditWhen.en: B+C selected with cost 80 and 155 views
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 选 B+C，费用 80、浏览量 155

fullCreditWhen.en: Note distinguishes summed views from unique reach
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 说明区分浏览量相加与独立触达人数

title.zh-CN: 编辑空间有限的提示牌

description.en: Mock library sign must list return point downstairs, due time 18:00, and receipts at the desk. Space allows three lines.
description.zh-CN: 模拟图书馆告示必须列出：楼下归还点、18:00 截止、柜台领取收据。版面仅三行。

instructions.en: Write three action-oriented lines. Preserve the facts and record what order makes them quickest to scan.
instructions.zh-CN: 写三行以行动开头的内容，保留事实，并说明哪种顺序最便于扫读。

expectedDeliverable.zh-CN: 三行提示牌及排序理由。

fullCreditWhen.en: Exactly three lines, with one main instruction per line
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 恰好三行，每行一个主要指令

fullCreditWhen.en: Downstairs, 18:00, and desk receipt all included
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 包含楼下、18:00 和柜台领取收据

fullCreditWhen.en: Rationale accounts for the visitor’s next action
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 排序理由考虑访客下一步行动

description.en: Simulated weights: paper 12 kg, mixed waste 18 kg, compost 10 kg. For this exercise, paper and compost are divertible.
description.zh-CN: 模拟重量：纸张 12 千克、混合垃圾 18 千克、堆肥物 10 千克。题目中纸张和堆肥物可分流。

instructions.en: Compute total and diversion share. Draw a labeled graphic and identify the largest category.
instructions.zh-CN: 计算总量及分流比例，绘制带标签的图，指出最大类别。

expectedDeliverable.zh-CN: 计算及带标签图表。

fullCreditWhen.en: Total 40 kg
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 总量 40 千克

fullCreditWhen.en: Diversion 22 kg or 55%
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 分流 22 千克，即 55%

fullCreditWhen.en: Mixed waste labeled as largest category
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 标出混合垃圾是最大类别

description.en: Two toy four-day logs: A 0,4,8,0 mm; B 2,2,2,6 mm. Treat a wet day as >0 mm.
description.zh-CN: 两组模拟四日记录：A 为 0、4、8、0 毫米；B 为 2、2、2、6 毫米。有雨日定义为超过 0 毫米。

instructions.en: Plot both series on common axes, compare totals, wet-day counts, and peak timing. Do not make a real forecast.
instructions.zh-CN: 在同一坐标轴绘制两序列，比较总量、有雨日数及峰值时点。不发布真实预报。

expectedDeliverable.zh-CN: 合并图及对照表。

fullCreditWhen.en: Totals equal 12 mm each
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 两站总量均为 12 毫米

fullCreditWhen.en: Wet days A 2 and B 4
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: A 有雨 2 天，B 有雨 4 天

fullCreditWhen.en: Peak days A 3 and B 4 accurately labeled
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 准确标注 A 在第 3 天、B 在第 4 天达峰值

description.en: Fictional depots N has 7 kits and S 5. Need sites A 5, B 4, C 3. N can reach only A/B. S can reach B/C. Paper exercise only.
description.zh-CN: 虚构仓库 N 有 7 套、S 有 5 套。需求点 A 需 5 套、B 需 4 套、C 需 3 套。N 仅能到达 A/B，S 仅能到达 B/C。仅为纸面练习。

instructions.en: Make a feasible allocation and show an unmet-demand contingency if N loses one kit. Avoid inventing real recipient profiles.
instructions.zh-CN: 制定可行分配，并说明 N 少一套时如何记录未满足需求。不编造现实受助者情况。

expectedDeliverable.zh-CN: 基线分配及应变表。

fullCreditWhen.en: Baseline sends N→A 5, N→B 2, S→B 2, S→C 3
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 基线 N→A 5、N→B 2、S→B 2、S→C 3

fullCreditWhen.en: Contingency respects route and capacity limits
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 应变方案符合路线和容量限制

fullCreditWhen.en: Contingency identifies exactly one kit of unmet need without double counting
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 应变方案明确缺一套且不重复统计

description.en: Mock room runs 10 lights rated 20 W for 5 h/day. Plan A changes to 12 W, same hours. Plan B keeps 20 W but runs 3 h/day.
description.zh-CN: 模拟房间使用 10 盏 20 瓦灯，每天五小时。方案 A 用 12 瓦，时长相同；方案 B 仍 20 瓦，每天三小时。

instructions.en: Compute baseline and plan daily kWh. Compare savings and identify one input to check in a real audit. Do not touch equipment.
instructions.zh-CN: 计算基线及方案的日千瓦时，比较节能量，指出实际审计中需核实的一项输入。不接触设备。

expectedDeliverable.en: Three-scenario calculation and one verification question.
expectedDeliverable.zh-CN: 三个场景的计算及一个核实问题。

fullCreditWhen.en: Baseline 1.0 kWh; both plans 0.6 kWh
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 基线 1.0 千瓦时，两方案均为 0.6 千瓦时

fullCreditWhen.en: Both plans save 0.4 kWh per day
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 两方案每天均节省 0.4 千瓦时

fullCreditWhen.en: Question names an uncertain input such as actual hours
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 问题指出一项不确定输入，如实际使用时长

description.en: Synthetic survey: transect A length 50, counts 5; B length 100, counts 7; C length 100, counts unknown. Same arbitrary length unit.
description.zh-CN: 模拟调查：样带 A 长 50、计数 5，B 长 100、计数 7，C 长 100、计数未知。长度单位一致。

instructions.en: Compute counts per 100 units for observed transects. Mark missingness and explain why raw totals alone mislead.
instructions.zh-CN: 对有观测数据的样带计算每 100 单位计数。标明缺失，并解释为何只看原始总数可能误导。

expectedDeliverable.en: Standardized rate table and limitation note.
expectedDeliverable.zh-CN: 标准化比率表及局限说明。

fullCreditWhen.en: A reports 10 and B 7 per 100
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 每 100 单位计数为 A 10、B 7

fullCreditWhen.en: C remains unknown, not zero
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: C 保持未知而非零

fullCreditWhen.en: Note explains the reversal relative to raw counts
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 说明解释相对于原始计数的排序反转

title.en: Synthesize feedback for a shared space

description.en: Invented feedback: two comments want shaded seating; one requests step-free access; one wants evening hours; one says evenings are too noisy.
description.zh-CN: 虚构反馈：两条希望设置遮阴座椅，一条要求无台阶通行，一条想在晚间开放，一条说夜间太吵。

instructions.en: Build an issue matrix with counts, represent the evening conflict, and write a neutral question for the next discussion.
instructions.zh-CN: 制作含计数的问题矩阵，呈现晚间使用冲突，写一个供下一轮讨论的中立问题。

expectedDeliverable.zh-CN: 问题矩阵及讨论提示。

fullCreditWhen.en: All five comments represented without collapsing opposing views
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 呈现全部五条反馈，不合并相反观点

fullCreditWhen.en: Shade count is two and access is visible despite lower count
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 遮阴计数为二，无台阶通行虽票数少仍清楚列出

fullCreditWhen.en: Question allows input from both evening viewpoints
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 提问允许持不同晚间观点的人表达意见

title.zh-CN: 比较虚构暴露风险排序

description.en: Toy score is hazard × exposure. Site A present 2×6 and future 4×6; B present 3×5 and future 3×5; C present and future 1×8.
description.zh-CN: 模拟分值为危险程度 × 暴露度。A 当前 2×6、未来 4×6，B 当前及未来均为 3×5，C 当前及未来均为 1×8。

instructions.en: Compute and rank each scenario, test future A if exposure drops to 3, and name a limitation of the toy score.
instructions.zh-CN: 计算各情景并排序，测试 A 未来暴露度降至 3 的结果，并说明模拟分值的一项局限。

expectedDeliverable.en: Ranked scenario table plus sensitivity note.
expectedDeliverable.zh-CN: 排序情景表及敏感性说明。

fullCreditWhen.en: Present ranks B 15, A 12, C 8
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 当前排序为 B 15、A 12、C 8

fullCreditWhen.en: Future ranks A 24, B 15, C 8
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 未来排序为 A 24、B 15、C 8

fullCreditWhen.en: Adjusted A becomes 12 and note names an unmodeled factor
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 调整后 A 为 12，说明列出未建模因素

title.zh-CN: 编写可操作的项目指标

description.en: A fictional tool library wants more residents to return equipment on time and fewer borrowing instructions left unanswered.
description.zh-CN: 虚构工具图书馆希望更多居民按期归还设备，并减少借用说明未得到解答的情况。

instructions.en: Convert both aims to indicators with numerator, denominator, and collection window. Define which direction is desirable.
instructions.zh-CN: 将两个目标转化为具有分子、分母及收集时段的指标，并定义理想变化方向。

expectedDeliverable.zh-CN: 两行测量方案。

fullCreditWhen.en: First indicator measures on-time returns against eligible returns
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 第一项衡量在应归还件数中的按期归还情况

fullCreditWhen.en: Second indicator measures unresolved questions against questions received
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 第二项衡量在收到问题中的未解决比例

fullCreditWhen.en: Both windows and desired directions explicitly stated
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 两项均明确时段和理想变化方向

description.en: Simulated graph: depot→A 10 min, A→B 5, B→depot 10, A→C 12, C→depot 10; edges reversible. Budget 35 minutes including 5 minutes per site.
description.zh-CN: 模拟网络：库房到 A 10 分钟，A 到 B 5，B 到库房 10，A 到 C 12，C 到库房 10；边可双向。预算 35 分钟，每个点观察五分钟计入。

instructions.en: Compare depot–A–B–depot and depot–A–C–depot. Choose a feasible route and include a two-item sampling-log template. Do not visit any site.
instructions.zh-CN: 比较库房–A–B–库房和库房–A–C–库房，选可行路线并给出两项采样日志模板。不走访场地。

expectedDeliverable.zh-CN: 路线计算及日志模板。

fullCreditWhen.en: A/B route totals 35 minutes
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: A/B 路线合计 35 分钟

fullCreditWhen.en: A/C route totals 42 minutes and exceeds the budget
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: A/C 路线合计 42 分钟，超预算

fullCreditWhen.en: Log provides site ID and a checkable observation field
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 日志提供点位编号及可核查的观察字段

description.en: Toy storage starts at 60 L, receives 30 L, and dispenses 25 L. End meter reads 62 L. No equipment or samples are involved.
description.zh-CN: 模拟容器初始 60 升，进水 30 升，出水 25 升，末表读数 62 升。不涉及设备或样本。

instructions.en: Compute expected end and meter minus expected. Propose a document check and state why discrepancy alone cannot prove a leak.
instructions.zh-CN: 计算预期末量及读数减预期的差异，提出一项文档核对，并说明仅凭差异为何不能证明泄漏。

expectedDeliverable.zh-CN: 平衡工作表及复核说明。

fullCreditWhen.en: Expected end is 65 L
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 预期末量 65 升

fullCreditWhen.en: Meter minus expected is -3 L
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 读数减预期为 -3 升

fullCreditWhen.en: Verification note names an alternative such as an entry or timing error
fullCreditWhen.zh-CN: 复核说明提出记录或时间误差等其他可能原因
